title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Ariana Cole
description: Add a set of RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts across SDKs and the docs site. Motivation: provide engineers with battle-tested examples for common RAG + agent workflows (search-backed QA, calendar agent, HTTP tool-calling, and streaming tool output). This PR bundles example code (redwood-examples), SDK quickstarts (python/typescript), and docs site pages with diagrams and runnable snippets. Changes are small and focused: templates, README quickstarts, docs pages, and a new test harness for agent examples. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and agent recipes - [x] Add Python and TS quickstarts using Redwood SDKs - [x] Add docs site pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add example E2E test harness for sample agents - [x] Update changelog and release notes Related: Linear ENG-4123 (RAG templates), ENG-4189 (agent quickstarts), DOCS-127 (docs site sidebar update). Testing: unit tests for example harness, manual smoke tests on dev docs build, CI run for SDK examples. Rollout: docs pages are behind feature flag docs.rag_examples=false by default and will be toggled on after initial canary review.
commits: feat(docs): add rag templates and agent recipes (python/ts)
feat(examples): add search-backed QA and calendar agent samples

fix(tests): fix flaky example integration test
